title: Rams Head On Stage

services.name: SUSTO -Solo (Matinee)
services.desc: AXS Mobile ID tickets is our only digital ticket option and are only accessible in the AXS Mobile App. Your confirmation email will not be accepted as a ticket to the show. Every concert goer must have a mobile ID ticket to enter the venue. Rams Head does not endorse using any secondary ticketing sources. Our Box Office can not resolve any issues involving them, such as lost or fake tickets. Tickets for all of our shows are sold through AXS, via our website or AXS App, or in person at the Box Office at 33 West Street in Annapolis. Rams Head is an all-ages venue, however we ask that a parent or guardian accompany any underage guests. An ID verifying age 21 and over is required to consume

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: If you are unable to dine with us in the Tavern prior to your show (and receive 10% off when you sign-up for the Premium On Stage Experience), we have a specially created menu available in the venue. Check out the On Stage menu below! Cream Of Crab Soup $8 Lump crab, sherry, old bay. Tuna Poke $15 Ahi Tuna, pineapple-lime dressing, avocado, cucumber, seaweed salad, fried wontons. Whiskey Blues Chips $10 Chips, bacon, bourbonzola cream sauce, balsamic glaze, bleu cheese crumbles, green onions. Antipasti Salad $9 Olives, roasted peppers, cucumber, red onion, pickled peppers, feta cheese, pita bread. Add salami & prosciutto $4 Crab Dip $17 Lump crab, cream cheese jalapeño, cheddar jack cheese.
